title: Finding Summary Counts
description: The shared count-of-findings shape, referenced by any report or persisted artifact that groups findings by severity plus resolved/new/ack. `open` is by severity over UNRESOLVED findings (NEW/OPEN/REGRESSED, per finding-status.schema.json); resolved/new/ack are orthogonal status counts over the same set. Extracted so review-finding-report.schema.json and review-artifact.schema.json share one definition instead of two copies. Value shape only; which findings count where is owned by review-report-standards.
